<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.073 Da. This is most consistent with a protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺ of a neutral compound of formula C₉H₁₀O₄ (exact monoisotopic mass 182.0579 Da, giving [M+H]⁺ = 182.0652 Da, within the typical measurement tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound in the sample is C₉H₁₀O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
